name: Encrypt - Vault Transit
description: Adds HashiCorp Vault's Transit secrets engine (encryption-as-a-service) as an encryption method for the Encrypt module.
project_description: Encrypt - Vault Transit plugs the Encrypt module into HashiCorp Vault's Transit secrets engine, providing an "encryption-as-a-service" encryption method. Instead of holding an encryption key on the Drupal server, the module sends data to Vault's /transit/encrypt and /transit/decrypt endpoints so the key material never leaves Vault. It ships one Encrypt EncryptionMethod plugin (vault_transit) plus a Key module KeyType and KeyInput that let an Encryption Profile reference a named Vault transit key. The Vault server address, TLS settings, and authentication token are supplied by the separate Vault module (with the token stored via the Key module); this module contributes no admin form, route, permission, or config object of its own. Part of the Vault for Drupal suite; requires the Encrypt, Key, and Vault modules.
